methods: Read fixed source and implementation contracts, historical CUSTOMER-ACQUISITION-PLAN.md and PILOT-DELIVERY.md as plans only.
Read current public home, Job Loop and contact HTML with web reader on 2026-10-14; pilot retrieval was unavailable.
Checked current official Product Hunt, Show HN and BetaList rules on 2026-10-14.
Ran npm run test:run -- src/__tests__/pilot-landing.test.tsx src/__tests__/pilot-demo.test.tsx src/__tests__/guest-support.test.tsx --maxWorkers=4: 3 files and 27 tests passed.
Incidental earlier hardening-audit snippets returned by a broad search were excluded; independent conclusions use direct source/public evidence.
not_tested: No authenticated/private customer journey or data inspected.
No email reception, live support creation/admin reply, pilot admission or actual user sessions tested.
No paid model/search calls, customer contacts, signup, publication or purchases.
No browser-interaction or full PDF/DOCX visual/download journey; web-reader HTML is not interaction verification.
No traffic, conversion, willingness-to-pay or hiring-outcome validation.

criteria.name: Promise and audience clarity
criteria.evidence: ProductPage.tsx:127-146 and observed https://jobvance.io/: clear free CV + vacancy review/download with fictional examples.

criteria.name: Destination and pilot admission
criteria.evidence: PilotLanding.tsx:108-120 intentionally prepares an unsent request; JobLoopOverview.tsx:21-23 discloses ten places; request receipt/admission untested.

criteria.name: Demonstration and launch assets
criteria.evidence: PilotDemo.tsx:26-51,121,168-178; public/pilot-demo-guide.txt; 27 focused pilot/demo/support tests passed.

criteria.name: Support, capacity and rollback
criteria.evidence: GuestSupport.tsx:15-18; GuestSupportInbox.tsx:11-14; ADMIN-PORTALS-GUIDE.md:13-40; live contact explains receipt limitations; operations rehearsal untested.

criteria.name: Learning and distribution gates
criteria.evidence: ADMIN-PORTALS-GUIDE.md:25-34 exposes guest/return coverage limits; historical pilot thresholds are plans, not real-user results; current channel fit remains a hypothesis.

strengths: Free guest entry leads with one concrete task and optional account saving.
Fictional demonstration preserves source contribution and projected-result qualifiers; approvals reset on changes.
Pilot and proposed pricing are distinguished from sales; ten seats and shared processing ceiling are explicit.
Named operator and private receipt/reply path allow support without signup; account metric limits are disclosed.

findings.problem: Assisted concept pilot and available saved workflow have different promises, so an invitation may not establish the task and assistance being tested.

evidence.detail: Assisted, prewritten research workflow; line 97 agrees a task over two weeks and line 128 calls richer demo proposed.
Home describes saved Job Loop as available in the free pilot.
Public Job Loop describes selected feeds, optional schedules and ten places.

findings.recommendation: Create a dated one-page pilot brief per invitation specifying input, one task, exact deliverable, optional cloud route and human assistance.
acceptance_criteria: Participant can explain input, output, help offered and next action before starting.
Current /pilot, /check and /job-loop links distinguish demonstration, guest task and saved workflow.
dependencies: Founder selects one test task and assistance boundary.

findings.problem: Unsent draft creation is not verified pilot reception, admission or session agreement.

evidence.detail: Draft does not register or reserve a session; lines 110-120 show memory-only draft and mailto/copy/download.
Destination is contact@jobvance.io; no delivery result established.
Current pilot seat count, mailbox reception and admission operation were not exercised.

findings.recommendation: Rehearse owner-controlled reception and manual acknowledgment; use a minimal private intake register for received date, source, consent, agreed task/date and admission status.
acceptance_criteria: Mailbox reception and manual acknowledgment demonstrated with owner-controlled test.
Copy/download fallback explains how to send; QA and real seats reconciled before invitation.
No draft-prepared count is reported as a received request.
dependencies: Owner test authorization for later execution

findings.problem: Available account counters cannot establish complete guest completion, opened exports or voluntary second use.

evidence.detail: Funnel tracks requested links; lines 31-34 distinguish observed week-two actions, scheduled repetition and untracked guest/download coverage.

findings.recommendation: Use a consented ten-person outcome sheet for persona, actual task, opened approved export, material corrections, founder minutes, abandonment and self-initiated second task. Treat 6/10 usable completion and 4/10 voluntary repeat as provisional expansion hypotheses, not benchmarks.
acceptance_criteria: All admitted participants have an observed outcome or documented missing observation.
Report denominators and assistance; verify exports were opened.
Week-two decision records no unresolved critical privacy/export incident, capacity and committed spend.
Scheduled runs do not substitute for voluntary return.
findings.cost_effect: $0 analytics service; keep all paid activity within shared $50 UTC-month ceiling.

findings.problem: Guest receipt/reply UI exists, but current operating guide's daily triage instruction addresses account support; guest operating coverage is not verified.

evidence.detail: Named maintainer and receipt limitations, not a response-time promise.
Open/update/reply exists; receipt holder reads reply without email.
Live contact exposes anonymous receipt path and 90-day consent.

findings.recommendation: Add guest queue review, absence cover and incident pause criteria to one current runbook; rehearse synthetic receipt→administrator reply→holder read.
acceptance_criteria: Fictional receipt reply is read using its code.
Daily queue review logged during pilot days.
Repeated failures pause expansion; whole-account requests use the separate scope.

findings.problem: No verified channel fit or real-user outcome justifies simultaneous directory distribution; BetaList is currently paid.

evidence.detail: Product Hunt checklist requires a direct product URL and concise assets.
Show HN expects a usable product, ideally without signup, and maker discussion.
BetaList support states all submissions require payment; checked 2026-10-14.

findings.recommendation: Prepare one factual kit: description, icon, fictional screenshots, captioned demo/transcript, limits, support link and maker explanation. After pilot gates, test Product Hunt or eligible Show HN sequentially; direct Show HN to /check. Exclude BetaList in current no-paid-launch scope.
acceptance_criteria: One reviewed kit and one channel experiment at a time.
Maker available for discussion; no vote solicitation, bulk directories or fabricated proof.
Assess qualified completion and useful feedback rather than rank/votes.

open_questions: How many of ten seats are currently occupied by real participants versus QA accounts?
Does contact@jobvance.io receive incoming requests and who acknowledges them?
Which single task and human-assistance boundary will each invitation test?
Who covers guest support during founder absence?
What actual opened-output and voluntary-return evidence exists? None was inspected here.
do_not_build_now: Paid checkout or tier entitlements as a launch prerequisite.
Directory-submission automation, paid launch packages or bulk listings.
Referral rewards, fabricated testimonials/counts/results or leaderboard tactics.
Separate products for each persona or more integrations to create launch spectacle.

launch_sequence.input: Current pilot brief and fictional CV/vacancy/request/support test
launch_sequence.output: Dated intake, opened export, capacity and reply evidence
launch_sequence.go_no_go: Go only when reception, task, capacity and reply are verified.
Go only with support coverage and resolved severe blockers; manual invitations only when separately authorized.

launch_sequence.input: First cohort results and current seats/spend
launch_sequence.output: Up to ten participants and week-two learning decision
launch_sequence.go_no_go: Go within actual capacity and allowance; hold if founder effort hides failure.

launch_sequence.input: Pilot gate decision and reviewed launch kit
launch_sequence.output: One Product Hunt or eligible Show HN feedback experiment
launch_sequence.go_no_go: Go with usable guest path, maker availability and later publication authorization; judge qualified completion.
